title: B.C. post-secondary application portal affected by data breach
summary: In a Thursday update, EducationPlannerBC says that, on Nov. 3, it identified a "cybersecurity incident affecting its application system."

image.caption: EducationPlannerBC says it is temporarily offline after indentifying a cybersecurity incident affecting its application system. (RedPixel/stock.adobe.com)

blocks.text: In a Thursday update, EducationPlannerBC says that, on Nov. 3, it identified a "cybersecurity incident affecting its application system."
EducationPlannerBC says it's working with post-secondary institutions to 'minimize impacts' on applicants
The application portal for public post-secondary institutions in British Columbia has been temporarily offline for over a week following a data breach.

It confirmed "an unauthorized actor gained access to a limited amount of applicant data including applicant names, contact details and gender," but said information such as social insurance numbers, banking or financial information were not accessed.

The update went on to say EducationPlannerBC "recognizes that being offline may cause concern for applicants with upcoming program deadlines and is working closely with its post-secondary institutional partners to minimize impacts on applicants."

items: Cybercriminals may have accessed medical diagnoses in Burnaby school district attack: officials
Russian hacker group claims to have posted B.C. school district information on dark web

blocks.text: In a statement, the University of British Columbia says it's committed to ensuring no student application is adversely affected by the outage.
Simon Fraser University says its applications for the 2027 fall term close at the end of January, and there are no plans to extend application deadlines.
News of the data breach comes after a cyberattack that affected the Burnaby School District.
A CBC News investigation found that a Russian ransomware group posted screenshots on the dark web from what appears to be a database stolen from the Burnaby School District.
